cluster.description: Cluster name, exactly as returned by list_clusters.

end.description: Range end, same forms as start. Defaults to now.

format.description: Output encoding. compact is columnar; table is fixed-width text; json is the raw Prometheus shape.

matchers.description: One or more PromQL series selectors, e.g. ["up{job=\"api\"}"]. A bare label name is not a selector.

start.description: Range start. Relative ("now-1h") or RFC 3339. Defaults to now-1h.
